title: Subsequence After One Replacement
summary: Given strings s and t of lowercase English letters, determine if s can become a subsequence of t by replacing at most one character in s.
statement: Given strings s and t of lowercase English letters, determine if s can become a subsequence of t by replacing at most one character in s.
constraints: You may replace at most one character of s with another lowercase letter.
Characters may not be deleted from s, but the resulting s only needs to be a subsequence of t.
Return whether such a choice exists.
hints: Track the longest prefix matched with zero replacements and with at most one replacement.
At each t character, the changed state may consume it as the one replacement after the unchanged prefix.
Also advance either state on exact character matches.
These two states cover every position where the optional replacement could occur.
